scientific_integrity.claim_basis: Exact simultaneous peak-contraction bijection, positional signed-character expansion, binary digit-sum inequality, Narayana symmetry
scientific_integrity.verification: Independent Dyck enumeration and integer Walsh transform checked all frequencies for semilengths 1-10; formula checked at every character for semilengths 1-8, and sampled at 9-10; all-order proof is explicit in RESULT.md

scientific_limitations: No complete nullity formula for even semilengths
No claim of a universally sharp positive multiplier gap
Unindexed equivalent signed positional-peak treatments may exist; bibliographic search does not prove uniqueness
An accessible full-text copy of the 2003 height-avoidance source was not located; its stated object differs from positional marking
title: Dyadic Walsh rigidity of positional peaks in Dyck paths
